headline: Start-up Origin has come out of stealth with $20 million to put robots that finish drywall onto construction sites.
score_reason: Concrete robot at work and funding, but small scale and company-reported performance.
importance_line: Builders facing labour shortages and drywall finishers may be affected, but the robot is still in pilots and the 'three times human speed' figure is the company's own.
summary: AI Insider reports, citing the company, that Origin has come out of stealth with $20 million co-led by Accel and Zacua Ventures to deploy OG-1, a robot that applies compound, sands and primes drywall on construction sites, with pilots planned with two large US contractors and sites in four other countries. Origin says the robot works at three times human speed, a figure based on its own deployments, and targets 150 robots by the end of 2027.
notes: Company claims relayed by AI Insider.
